Interesting stance to take. Care to elaborate? (On both Star Wars/Quantum Leap)

Each relies on a mystical power to fill in what would otherwise be major plot holes. Star wars has "the force" which may as well be magic. Quantum leap has God. In QL the writer wanted the main character to be jumping about solving problems but he couldn't figure out an immersive reason a time traveler would do such a thing. Rather than creating some character depth and inventing some mechanics he invokes God. It's lazy. And it's not the only reason God is invoked. Any time the series needs a deus ex it falls back to that.

It has enough science. Both Star Wars and Quantum Leap are still in some subgenre of sci-fi. Imagination is enough. You don't have to fully explain a mechanic, and you are allowed to attribute things to a higher power. Tons of sci-fi shows do this from Battlestar Galatica to Star Trek. I don't know why this is the first thing you have to say about a great show nor why you think it's a valid point.
